title: Compute electro-optic coefficients and birefringence
action: Implement the numerical calculations: from the given ionic polarizabilities, lattice parameters, piezoelectric coefficients, refractive index, and dielectric constants, compute the linearized ionic dipole moments, the total piezoelectric optical polarization, the piezoelectric contributions to r33 and birefringence, the Kerr-effect-induced polarization changes, the clamped Kerr contributions to r13 and r33, scale to free r33, and compute total r33_free and total δn. Output all quantities in a JSON file.
description: A JSON object containing all computed electro-optic quantities.
output_schema: Object with keys: r33_piezo (float, m/V), r33_Kerr_clamp (float, m/V), r33_Kerr_free (float, m/V), r33_free (float, m/V), r13_Kerr_clamp (float, m/V), delta_n_piezo (float, dimensionless), delta_n_Kerr (float, dimensionless), delta_n_total (float, dimensionless).
